content.text: I'll query the data to find how many tenants have a negative total gross margin.

input.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id) as tenant_count
FROM fct_tenant_margin
GROUP BY tenant_id
HAVING SUM(gross_margin_usd) < 0

content.text: Let me adjust the query to properly count the tenants with negative total gross margin:

input.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as tenant_count
FROM (
  SELECT tenant_id, SUM(gross_margin_usd) as total_margin
  FROM fct_tenant_margin
  GROUP BY tenant_id
  HAVING SUM(gross_margin_usd) < 0
) subquery

content.text: **Zero tenants have a negative total gross margin** [E2]. All tenants in the dataset maintain positive cumulative gross margins across their features and time periods. This indicates healthy profitability across the entire tenant base.
